name: Matrix M71: negative bar and column charts

slides.title: M71 horizontal bars, short names, two below zero

chart.alt: Margin by product; leasing and repairs below zero

slides.notes: M71 slide 1. Negative-value bar chart, four short category names (Cranes, Software, Leasing, Repairs), two values below zero, data labels. Look at the category names left of the bars: every name whole ('Cranes', not 'ranes'), inside the chart frame, at the low edge of the plot (not at the zero line).

slides.title: M71 horizontal bars, long names, two below zero

chart.alt: Margin by product line; leasing and repairs below zero

slides.notes: M71 slide 2. Negative-value bar chart with four long category names of four to five words. Look at the names left of the bars: whole, wrapped if needed, none cut at the frame edge.

slides.title: M71 horizontal bars, twelve categories, four below zero

chart.alt: Margin by service; rail, leasing, towage and reefers below zero

slides.notes: M71 slide 3. Negative-value bar chart with twelve short categories, four below zero. Look at all twelve names left of the bars: whole and inside the frame; none overlapping its neighbor.

slides.title: M71 vertical columns, short names, two below zero

chart.alt: Margin by product; leasing and repairs below zero

slides.notes: M71 slide 4. Negative-value column chart, four short category names (Cranes, Software, Leasing, Repairs), two values below zero, data labels. Look at the category names under the plot: every name whole ('Cranes', not 'ranes'), inside the chart frame, at the low edge of the plot (not at the zero line).

slides.title: M71 vertical columns, long names, two below zero

chart.alt: Margin by product line; leasing and repairs below zero

slides.notes: M71 slide 5. Negative-value column chart with four long category names of four to five words. Look at the names under the plot: whole, wrapped if needed, none cut at the frame edge.

slides.title: M71 vertical columns, twelve categories, four below zero

chart.alt: Margin by service; rail, leasing, towage and reefers below zero

slides.notes: M71 slide 6. Negative-value column chart with twelve short categories, four below zero. Look at all twelve names under the plot: whole and inside the frame; none overlapping its neighbor.

slides.title: M71 horizontal bars, two series, legend at the top, with axis titles

chart.alt: Margin by product in two years

slides.notes: M71 slide 7. Two-series negative bar chart with a top legend and both axis titles. Look at the category names left of the bars and the rotated 'Product' title: whole, not overlapping, inside the frame.

slides.title: M71 control: horizontal bars, all above zero
slides.notes: M71 slide 8. Control: the same short names, all values positive. 0.36.0 keeps the outer plot area here; names beside the bars as before.
